title: prd-readiness contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-253). The SHAPE of the prd-readiness contract data the L4 run-start gate branches on — the product-axis analog of spec-readiness. Shape is normative here; the verdict SEMANTICS (refuse on not-ready / fail-loud) live in the gateway + the call-site contract (ADR 0001). There is NO safe coerce target for a malformed verdict — faff's own producer emits it, so an out-of-enum verdict/creative_licence is a fail-loud (like spec-readiness/automation-routing), never coerced toward admissible.
